description: Creates a new outgoing webhook or changes one by id: what it fires on, where it delivers, how, and which field mapping and conditions it carries. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. A webhook fires for EVERY webinar on this site, not only the one in this chat, so say that in one sentence before you save. Needs `session_id`; `webhook_id` 0 or left out creates a new one, an id changes that one. `trigger` is registered, attended or purchased and is needed on create; `url` is the receiving system's own address and is never invented. `conditions` is how a lead is narrowed or a field renamed: [{field, operator, value?, field_name?, field_value?}], where operator map renames a field and equal or not_equal and the others apply a tag only for matching leads. Use only field names the site offers. `mirror_url` is a test copy that anyone with the link can read and that switches itself off after a few hours, so never offer it as the real destination. `active` true needs an active plan, exactly like the form. Read what exists with wi_list_webhooks, remove one with wi_delete_webhook, prove it with wi_test_webhook.

active.description: true turns it on so it really fires. Default is saved but silent.

conditions.description: Field mapping and conditions: [{field, operator, value?, field_name?, field_value?}].

mirror_url.description: An optional test copy address. Anyone with that link can read what is sent, and it turns itself off after a few hours. An empty string removes it.

name.description: The label in the webhook list. Auto-named from the trigger when left out on create.

secret.description: An optional signing secret the receiving system gave the host. Never guessed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

trigger.description: What makes it fire. Needed on create.

url.description: The receiving system's own delivery address. Needed on create, never invented.

webhook_id.description: 0 or left out creates a new webhook, an id changes that one.

name: wi_save_webhook
title: Save an outgoing webhook
